inputs.name: hand over from Production Drift Monitoring to Alerting System

output.level_0: Alerts fail to fire when drift is detected, leaving the team blind to production issues.
output.level_1: No connection exists, so drift signals never reach the alerting system at all.
output.level_2: Engineers manually check drift reports and send emails to trigger alerts when needed.
output.level_3: Drift metrics automatically push to the alerting system, generating notifications without human input.
output.level_4: Automated alerts are governed by policy, ensuring only valid drift signals trigger actionable notifications.
